notable_strengths: All 32 source spans checked extract to text that genuinely supports their sentences (span_support_rate 1.00); offsets are precise, often landing exactly on the key phrase.

Every quoted number was verified correct against raw tool logs: 5 Jenkins jobs, 12 plugins, exit-127 pnpm failure, 9m41s wall clock, 89% (32/36) turbo hit rate, 107 suites / 0 failed, 4m18s staging deploy, 31m52s→12m06s (-62%) and 48m23s→21m19s (-56%) three-run means, 21m19s→16m02s after remote/layer cache.

Spans drawn from very long tool logs (e.g. t045, a 47k-char jest log) are anchored deep in the log at the exact summary line rather than at the head, showing genuine offset-level provenance.
